verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs say failed Activities are automatically retried based on developer configuration, and its SDKs expose automatic retries as a core resilience API. A long-time user corroborates that any unit can be retried easily on failure and that non-retryable errors can be specified. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of backoff configuration (initial interval, backoff coefficient, max interval), and in-depth retry-policy documentation beyond one-line mentions.
